docs.title: About Denis Muriuki
docs.text:
I build and operate resilient systems. My engineering philosophy is heavily influenced by the logistical precision of John D. Rockefeller's Pocantico—focusing on uncompromising fundamentals, declarative infrastructure, and the elimination of operational waste.

Currently, I am building out enterprise networking and Linux automation labs while executing high-volume shift operations at GXO.

Current Trajectory
